affectedSurfaces: successful and failed builder calibration artifact provenance
hypothesis: Requiring twenty pass verdicts will stop 8–10-pass overlap volatility from being misread as evaluator drift while preserving every contradiction and the 25% threshold; source-verified repair evidence plus a mandatory open disposition task will prevent unrelated, aggregate-only, or undispositioned snapshots from closing the task.

metricsCompared.name: affected-sample disposition
metricsCompared.baseline: 3 of 10 pass verdicts contradicted (30.0%), gated with an 8-pass minimum
metricsCompared.candidate: the same 3 of 10 contradictions are preserved; 10 passes are insufficient under the 20-pass minimum and all three signals are bound to an open disposition task
metricsCompared.unit: monitor-produced pass verdicts and contradiction edges

metricsCompared.name: historical small-window volatility
metricsCompared.baseline: 8–10-pass monitor windows gated at 30.0–44.4%; each overlap moved the rate by 10–12.5 points
metricsCompared.candidate: pass-contradiction gating starts at 20 passes; the unchanged 25% threshold still gates sustained drift
metricsCompared.unit: pass verdicts required for gate eligibility

metricsCompared.name: unrelated calibration evidence accepted
metricsCompared.baseline: any artifact with totalRuns > 0 and a non-gated label could pass without source or config provenance
metricsCompared.candidate: the gate verifies the claimed task's latest Git snapshot, all aggregate fields, active config, recomputed decision, at least two distinct monitor-history refs, and a source-bound open task covering every weak-evidence signal

metricsCompared.name: stale artifacts accepted as post-repair evidence
metricsCompared.baseline: closing-run and concurrent pre-fix artifacts could appear later by wall clock
metricsCompared.candidate: repair recreation requires a source revision descended from the repair-closing commit

metricsCompared.name: pre-restart definitions consuming source-changing handoffs
metricsCompared.baseline: the build-committed event could dispatch before restart
metricsCompared.candidate: restart pauses dispatch before the persisted handoff is consumed by reloaded definitions

rationale: The candidate uses the task's explicit gate-retune path. It does not claim access to missing per-run artifacts, alter historical verdicts, deduplicate contradictions, widen the 25% rate, or pad the denominator. Six monitor-generated task snapshots show a sharp volume split: 73–74-pass windows held at 2.7%, while 8–10-pass windows oscillated at 30–44.4%. Twenty passes makes the proportion less sensitive to individual overlaps. The blocking evidence decoder ties the decision to the claimed snapshot and active config, and it requires the three retained weak-evidence signals to remain assigned to an open source-bound disposition task.
